header.running_head: Being Stern with those who Oppose the Commands of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text:
Hurayrah (RA) was also a witness, Hadhrat Umar (RA) sent for him. "What have you seen?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA). Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) replied, "Although I did not actually see him drink anything, I did see him in a state of intoxication and vomiting." Hadhrat Umar (RA) remarked, "You are very precise in your testimony."
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then wrote to Hadhrat Qudaamah (RA) to come to him from Bahrain. When Hadhrat Qudaamah (RA) arrived, Hadhrat Jaarood (RA) said, "Enforce Allaah's penalty on him." "Are you a plaintiff or a witness?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked. "I am a witness," Hadhrat Jaarood (RA) replied. "Then you have already rendered your affidavit." Hadhrat Umar (RA) reminded him. Hadhrat Jaarood (RA) kept quiet but returned to Hadhrat Umar (RA) the next morning to demand that the penalty be enforced. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to him, "To me you seem to be a plaintiff and have but only one witness." "I am then telling you (to enforce the penalty) in the name of Allaah!" Hadhrat Umar (RA) cautioned him saying, "Do control your tongue before I have to punish you!" Hadhrat Jaarood (RA) commented, "O Umar! It is wrong for you to punish me when it is your cousin who has drunk wine." Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) then spoke saying, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! If you doubt our testimony, send for the daughter of Waleed and ask her. She is Qudaamah's wife."
Hadhrat Umar (RA) then sent for Hind bint Waleed and asked her to testify in the name of Allaah. When she testified against her husband, Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to Hadhrat Qudaamah (RA), "I will be having you lashed." "If I did drink as you claim," Hadhrat Qudaamah (RA) argued, "you have no right to have me lashed." "Why is that?" asked Hadhrat Umar (RA). Hadhrat Qudaamah (RA) replied, "Because Allaah states:

blocks.arabic_text: لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيْمَا طَعِمُوْٓا اِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاٰمَنُوْا ثُمَّ اتَّقَوْا وَّاَحْسَنُوْا وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ
blocks.text: There is no sin on those who have Imaan and who do righteous acts for what they have eaten when they have adopted Taqwa (abstained from Haraam acts), had Imaan and performed good actions, then again adopted Taqwa and had Imaan; and again adopted Taqwa and performed good actions. Allaah loves those who do good.'"

Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to him, "You have misinterpreted the verse. Had you adopted Taqwa, you would have refrained from that which Allaah has forbidden." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then turned to the people and asked, "What do you say about having Qudaamah lashed?" The people replied, "We think that he should not be lashed as long as he is ill."
